business_problem: MONO-X needed a modernization path for customers running IBM i workloads so they could reduce infrastructure costs, preserve continuity and adopt AI faster without discarding legacy systems.
solution_summary: MONO-X partnered with IBM to create a hybrid cloud modernization approach based on IBM Cloud and IBM Power Virtual Server. The company wrapped that architecture into a managed service called PVS One, which simplifies migration from on-premises IBM i environments into a cloud operating model. IBM Cloud serves as the integration layer while Power Virtual Server provides the core infrastructure for mission-critical workloads. On top of that foundation, MONO-X connected IBM watsonx Orchestrate so AI agents such as IBM Bob could interact with modernized environments, bridging COBOL-based systems and newer AI services. The design lets customers automate manual workloads, improve operational resilience and provision AI development environments far faster than with traditional data-center approaches, all while retaining the business value embedded in long-lived IBM i assets.
